fields.title: 📖 Do not speak without knowledge
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Do not follow that of which you have no knowledge; hearing, sight, and the heart will be called to account.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Takfīr, Ḥukm, and Muḥākamah without knowledge are dangerous. Whoever judges needs proof, not mere emotion.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Isrāʾ 17:36.
